{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Autumn evening at the theatre, neat social band, light-blue shoes requested. Outer layer needed for the weather.

Tailored midi skirt, A-line, falling just below the knee, deep navy (#1f2a44), fine wool crepe

Fitted refined knit top, slim cut with a boat neckline and long sleeves, ivory (#f3ece0), merino wool

Textured jacket, softly structured and cropped at the hip, single-breasted, charcoal-navy (#2b3350), wool bouclé

Pumps with a low block heel, rounded toe, light blue (#8fb8e0), smooth leather

Knee-high sheer tights, no wait, sheer tights, ankle to waist, in a soft smoke tone (#3a3a44), fine nylon

Small structured top-handle bag, deep navy (#1f2a44), matte leather

Drop earrings, small, in brushed silver (#c0c4cc), metal

Lightweight scarf, loosely draped, pale grey-blue (#b9c6d6), silk-wool blend

Why this works: The light-blue pumps are the focal point, and the navy skirt and jacket frame them so they look intentional rather than loud. The ivory knit brightens the face under artificial theatre lighting and echoes her cool, soft coloring, while the blue of the eyes is picked up by the shoes and scarf. The skirt, knit and textured jacket sit exactly in the neat social range, polished enough for an evening performance without feeling like cocktail wear. The jacket and wool layers keep her warm for an autumn evening, and the low block heel stays comfortable through a long seated show."}
